title: U.S. Bank completes live stablecoin transaction as institutional adoption advances
dek: U.S. Bank, the fifth-largest U.S. commercial bank, completed a live transaction using its USBDC stablecoin and is exploring its use for treasury payments, liquidity management, and collateral. The milestone represents concrete institutional adoption beyond initial pilots.
author: Crypto Cronkite
key_fact: The fifth-largest U.S. commercial bank has moved from exploration to live stablecoin transactions, signaling that tier-1 financial institutions are beginning to integrate blockchain-based treasury infrastructure.
bottom_line: U.S. Bank's next milestone will be either a public announcement of customer access to USBDC or a regulatory filing detailing the service's scope and pricing. The absence of either will indicate whether the transaction was a one-off validation or the beginning of institutional deployment.
body: U.S. Bank, the fifth-largest U.S. commercial bank, completed a live transaction using its USBDC stablecoin, according to CoinDesk reporting on September 8, 2026.

The transaction marks a concrete step beyond prior exploration of the token. U.S. Bank is now testing USBDC for treasury payments, liquidity management, and collateral applications, per CoinDesk. The move signals that tier-1 institutional banking infrastructure is beginning to move beyond proof-of-concept work into operational deployment of blockchain-based payment infrastructure.
The blockchain or settlement network on which USBDC operates was similarly not detailed.
